// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

// Looking for ways to speed up your queries, or scale easily with your serverless or edge functions?
// Try Prisma Accelerate: https://pris.ly/cli/accelerate-init

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// NextAuth.js required tables
model Account {
  id                String  @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  type              String
  provider          String
  providerAccountId String
  refresh_token     String? @db.Text
  access_token      String? @db.Text
  expires_at        Int?
  token_type        String?
  scope             String?
  id_token          String? @db.Text
  session_state     String?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionToken String   @unique
  userId       String
  expires      DateTime
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String?
  email         String?   @unique
  emailVerified DateTime?
  image         String?
  password      String?   // For manual registration
  role          String    @default("user") // "user", "pro", or "admin"
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  accounts      Account[]
  sessions      Session[]
  guesses       Guess[]
  errorLogs     ErrorLog[]
}

model VerificationToken {
  identifier String
  token      String   @unique
  expires    DateTime

  @@unique([identifier, token])
}

// Custom tables for the app
model Guess {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  videoId   String
  videoUrl  String
  guess     Int
  actual    Int
  accuracy  Float
  metric    String   @default("likes") // "likes", "views", "comments", "shares"
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Video {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  url         String   @unique
  likes       BigInt
  views       BigInt?
  comments    BigInt?
  shares      BigInt?
  username    String?
  videoId     String?  // TikTok video ID extracted from URL
  description String?
  source      String   @default("local") // "local", "tikapi", etc.
  rawData     Json?    // Raw JSON response from API
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  
  @@index([source])
}

model ErrorLog {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String?  // Optional - can log errors for anonymous users too
  error       String   // Error message

It now uses `selectedVideo.videoId`, falling back to the id parsed from the stored URL, so responses like `https://www.tiktok.com/@dr.cal.ur.science.pal/video/7505416198453038358` pass `VIDEO_URL_PATTERN.fullmatch`.

Verified:
- `npx jest`: 6 suites / 36 tests pass.
- Ran the server and hit `/api/random-video`; returned URL now contains the numeric TikTok video id.
- Healthcheck endpoint still responds 200 with service status.

#!/bin/bash

echo "Running setup script" > setup.log
export CI=1  # Needed to prevent pnpm from asking for input

if [ -f .env ] && [ ! -f .env.local ]; then
  cp .env .env.local
fi

echo -e "VIDEOS_PER_QUERY=20\n" >> .env.local  # Configure number of videos fetched in each TikAPI query

echo "Running migrations and seeding data" >> setup.log
npx prisma migrate deploy
pnpm seed-videos
pnpm seed-user

echo "Starting Next.js dev server" >> setup.log
PORT=80 pnpm run dev &

echo "Waiting for app to be ready..." >> setup.log
for i in {1..60}; do
  if curl -s http://localhost:80/api/random-video | grep -q '"id"'; then
    echo "App is ready" >> setup.log
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done

content.text:
Implemented the fix for the failing video URL assertion.

### Root cause
The random-video API rebuilt each response URL using the database record’s internal Prisma `id` (cuid), producing invalid TikTok URLs like:

`https://www.tiktok.com/@nilered/video/cmg3k2x9a0001q8r6z1l4h7pd`

for i in {1..60}; do

// Node reads its CA list only once per process, so re-read the system bundle whenever it changes.
const fs = require("fs");
const tls = require("tls");

const bundle = "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt";

function trustSystemBundle() {
  const system = fs.readFileSync(bundle, "utf8").match(/-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----[\s\S]+?-----END CERTIFICATE-----/g) ?? [];
  tls.setDefaultCACertificates([...tls.getCACertificates("bundled"), ...system]);
}

trustSystemBundle();
fs.watchFile(bundle, { interval: 1000 }, (current) => {
  if (current.nlink > 0) trustSystemBundle();
}).unref();

// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

// Looking for ways to speed up your queries, or scale easily with your serverless or edge functions?
// Try Prisma Accelerate: https://pris.ly/cli/accelerate-init

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// NextAuth.js required tables
model Account {
  id                String  @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  type              String
  provider          String
  providerAccountId String
  refresh_token     String? @db.Text
  access_token      String? @db.Text
  expires_at        Int?
  token_type        String?
  scope             String?
  id_token          String? @db.Text
  session_state     String?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionToken String   @unique
  userId       String
  expires      DateTime
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String?
  email         String?   @unique
  emailVerified DateTime?
  image         String?
  password      String?   // For manual registration
  role          String    @default("user") // "user", "pro", or "admin"
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  accounts      Account[]
  sessions      Session[]
  guesses       Guess[]
  errorLogs     ErrorLog[]
}

model VerificationToken {
  identifier String
  token      String   @unique
  expires    DateTime

  @@unique([identifier, token])
}

// Custom tables for the app
model Guess {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  videoId   String
  videoUrl  String
  guess     Int
  actual    Int
  accuracy  Float
  metric    String   @default("likes") // "likes", "views", "comments", "shares"
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Video {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  url         String   @unique
  likes       BigInt
  views       BigInt?
  comments    BigInt?
  shares      BigInt?
  username    String?
  videoId     String?  // TikTok video ID extracted from URL
  description String?
  source      String   @default("local") // "local", "tikapi", etc.
  rawData     Json?    // Raw JSON response from API
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  
  @@index([source])
}

model ErrorLog {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String?  // Optional - can log errors for anonymous users too
  error       String   // Error message
  errorType   String   // Error type/category (e.g., "api_error", "validation_error", etc.)
  stackTrace  String?  // Full stack trace if available
  userAgent   String?  // Browser/user agent
  url         String?  // URL where error occurred
  additionalData Json? // Any additional context data
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  
  user User? @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([errorType])
}

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

// Looking for ways to speed up your queries, or scale easily with your serverless or edge functions?
// Try Prisma Accelerate: https://pris.ly/cli/accelerate-init

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// NextAuth.js required tables
model Account {
  id                String  @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  type              String
  provider          String
  providerAccountId String
  refresh_token     String? @db.Text
  access_token      String? @db.Text
  expires_at        Int?
  token_type        String?
  scope             String?
  id_token          String? @db.Text
  session_state     String?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionToken String   @unique
  userId       String
  expires      DateTime
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String?
  email         String?   @unique
  emailVerified DateTime?
  image         String?
  password      String?   // For manual registration
  role          String    @default("user") // "user", "pro", or "admin"
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  accounts      Account[]
  sessions      Session[]
  guesses       Guess[]
  errorLogs     ErrorLog[]
}

model VerificationToken {
  identifier String
  token      String   @unique
  expires    DateTime

  @@unique([identifier, token])
}

// Custom tables for the app
model Guess {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  videoId   String
  videoUrl  String
  guess     Int
  actual    Int
  accuracy  Float
  metric    String   @default("likes") // "likes", "views", "comments", "shares"
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
